summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes a single two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title code; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added heading with a bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, skipped elsewhere). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code.
